name: xisha_yongle
attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2024. Accessed via Earth Search / AWS Sentinel-2 L2A COGs.
resampling: Bilinear warp from original 10m TCI to WGS84 equirectangular, approx10m; no AI/geometry alteration
notes: Single-day acquisition; not verified current2026 coastline. Reef/water colours are not dry-land outline.
visual_qa: Usable geographic reference; sea has white speckles (cloud/glint/waves not classified), do not interpret them as land; 31 zero boundary pixels.
